programs.faq1Q: How do I know my level?
programs.faq1A: Before starting you take a free placement test (written + short interview). The result places you in a class that fits — not too easy, not too hard.
programs.faq2Q: What's the difference between YCT, HSK, and TOCFL?
programs.faq2A: YCT is for kids & teens; HSK is China's standard (required by universities in China); TOCFL is Taiwan's standard (required in Taiwan). We help you choose based on your goal.
programs.faq3A: Transparent pricing per package and level — no hidden fees. Message us on WhatsApp for the current price list for your program and format.
programs.faq4A: Both. Online classes run as interactive video calls; offline classes are available at our location. Formats can be combined.
programs.faq5A: Yes! Your first trial class is free. Tap the WhatsApp button, mention the program you're interested in, and we'll schedule it.

about.metaDescription: The story of Orin Mandarin Learning Center (欧林中文): the bridge from a first Mandarin lesson to a university acceptance in China & Taiwan.
about.storyP1: Orin was born from a gap we kept seeing: Indonesian families bouncing between providers — a language school here, a placement agent there, and nobody holding the whole picture.
about.storyP2: We built that bridge. One team that teaches the language, understands the culture, and guides the application — from first character to acceptance letter.
about.missionDesc: Open doors to education and careers through Mandarin — with humane teaching and honest guidance.
about.method1Desc: Speak from the very first session; structure follows naturally.
about.method2Desc: Max 6 students per class — everyone gets speaking time, every session.
about.method3Desc: Progress maps to YCT/HSK/TOCFL levels so results are visible.
about.teamDesc: Certified native and local tutors, plus education counselors who studied in China and Taiwan themselves.
about.value1Desc: Recommendations based on your profile, not university commissions.
about.value2Desc: Learning a language is a long road — we walk it with you, without judgment.
about.value3Desc: Rooted in Indonesia, fluent in the Chinese-speaking world — we are the bridge.
